note: The main banks were taken as Lithuania's three largest by assets, a choice from general knowledge (no central bank or association ranking was read in this pass): SEB, Swedbank and Luminor. Swedbank Lithuania: its credit card page, comparison and representative examples, read 2026-10-30. The Classic (revolving) credit card costs 2 euros a month, the Gold 5 and the Platinum 16. Interest is fixed individually at issue, from 17%, 17% and 12% a year; the bank's own representative examples use a fixed 18% for the Classic and Gold cards and 13% for the Platinum, the rates written. The currency exchange fee is 2.45% on the Classic card and none on the Gold and Platinum up to 10,000 euros a month (2.45% above, a threshold not modelled). The interest-free periods are 25 days on the Classic card and 30 on the Gold for each purchase, and up to 50 days on the Platinum. The one-off issuing fee (2 euros by post, 5 at a branch) and the representative examples' minimum daily service fee aren't written; free cash withdrawals up to 500 or 1,000 euros a month are thresholds not modelled. SEB's and Luminor's card prices weren't reached in this pass and aren't written.
